messages:
Maya R.: FYI I opened a short PR to tidy the retention & audit notice copy in the docs — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542
Alex P.: skimmed. main legal ask: avoid "we keep" language; prefer "audit logs are retained by default" with config options called out.
Jordan K.: added bullet samples and an inline SDK snippet (curl + python) in the PR diff.
Claire L.: small UX nit — the notice reads like a policy; can we make the actionability clearer (e.g., how to change TTL in Console)?
Sam T.: added a Ruby snippet and a short curl example for export. snippet:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports \n  -d '{"range":"30d","format":"jsonl"}'
```
Maya R.: nice. Legal asked for SOC 2 mention but not a guarantee. suggest: "configured to meet SOC 2 evidence requirements"?
docs-bot: Reminder: don't reference specific control IDs in public docs without Legal sign-off :warning:
sara-legal: quick review — replace any "we store" with "logs are retained"; change "delete" -> "expire"; add link to Data Retention Policy (/policy/data-retention).
Alex P.: reword proposal:
- "Audit logs are retained by default for 30 days and may be exported by customers."
- "Customers can configure retention TTLs per-tenant via Console or API."
Jordan K.: pushed reword commit (force-push) at 1777777788 — ready for a final pass.
Claire L.: looks good, just one more UX tweak for the Console path (Settings → Data → Retention) and a screenshot placeholder.
Maya R.: tagging @sara-legal for final sign-off.
sara-legal: signed off, small tweak: change "may be exported" -> "can be exported by authorized users". also ensure we don't expose proof text implying SLAs.
Sam T.: merged PR and updated changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542/files#diff
Maya R.: deployed preview to staging docs site; leaving for 24h sanity checks. thanks all :tada:
